what_i_did: Copied models/feed-store/build.py (and run.sh, hero_iou.py; hero_check.py from family-home-charming) and kept its structure: the same 5 construction states from one STATE switch, origin at the footprint centre, door gable facing -Y, ridge along Y, and the same material names and roles. New material: Glass_Window (window panes); Timber_Ink is now teal paint for the FEED letters.

Everything is built straight from segmented vertical planks and posts, then warp() bends every vertex: walls bulge out about 5.5% at mid height and flare at the foot, the whole shed leans 3 cm per metre toward +X, and the roof is tipped so the front of the ridge sits higher than the back (the crooked roofline). Props are not warped.

2.3 x 2.0 m walls (W/D 1.15 vs 1.24 normal; overall bounds 3.64 x 3.66 m vs 3.15 x 3.11, both about square), lower 2.1 m eaves and a 1.35 m rise for chubbier proportions, 0.45 m eave and 0.28 m gable overhangs. The roof is a bell curve: steeper at the ridge, kicked out at the eaves.

Five staggered courses of 11 to 12 long, thick single shakes per slope in two teal tones, each with a ragged butt, a little skew and lift, over a dark-teal underboard; a lumpy teal ridge roll on top; a big pink ridge log that sags slightly and curls up into flared ends with pale end grain, the front one bigger.

Vertical rose planks (gable planks run up to the bell roof line), bowed chunky corner posts, tie beams with poking-out ends, knee braces, a 4-plank door with two ledges and a Z brace, a lintel log overhanging the jambs, two dark-paned windows with cross muntins and chunky sill and head on each eave wall, and a crooked wooden sign with big teal FEED letters nailed on the gable.
Three plump tied burlap sacks left of the door, an oversized dark scoop leaning right of the door, a little spilled grain. Round lumpy olive footing stones all round.

make_views.py writes views/: hero.png is the MJ hero with its ground band keyed out (the harness mask kept it), view_front.png is the sheet front, and the sheet's 'back' (actually the plain eave wall square-on) is used as view_side.png. The sheet's 'side' is a 3/4 view, so it is dropped; there is no back target. The sheet's ogee spire roof and arched door contradict the hero; the hero wins, so the sheet only guides the silhouette.
hero_iou.py: harness hero camera vs views/hero.png. hero_check.py: same lens from the MJ hero's own direction (0.70, -0.70, 0.15), lower than the harness's.

Triangles per state: planned 352, foundation 1300, frame 2492, roof 4198, complete 7496 (budget 9k). to_game.py feed-store-charming ran cleanly and installed into simulation-assets-charming/buildings/feed-store-*.{json,glb} with the intended roles (timber, roof, stone, cloth, fiber, food, metal, glass).
good: Reads as the same feed store gone storybook: bulging rose walls, a crooked bell roof of chunky teal shakes, curled ridge-log ends, FEED sign, door with Z brace, windows, sacks and scoop.
Drop-in: same states, conventions, material names and roughly square overall footprint as the normal model.
Hero IoU from the MJ direction 0.815; harness hero 0.727 (normal model 0.730).
off: Harness hero IoU is 0.727: the harness camera is higher than the illustration's, so it sees much more roof.
Sheet IoUs are about 0.70: the sheet draws a much taller, narrower spire roof (front aspect 1.39 vs 1.18) and its 'back' eave view has a very tall roof slab; I followed the hero.
The hero's sculpted wood grain, sack folds and lumpy hand-made shingle edges are flat-shaded low-poly here; the sacks read a little like jars up close.
The hero has a second line 'STORE' on the sign; left out (too small to read in the tile).

rounds.change: First charming build from the normal builder: toy warp (bulge, flare, lean, tilted ridge), bell roof of single shakes, vertical planks, windows, curled ridge log, ridge roll, three sacks. Hero (MJ dir) 0.734, harness hero 0.695.

Swept proportions and the MJ camera: depth 2.0, eaves 2.1, rise 1.35, eave overhang 0.45; MJ direction set to 9 degrees up. Hero (MJ dir) 0.83, harness hero 0.732; sheet scores fell (its roof is a spire).
Long thin shakes (11 per course), bigger sign, greyer burlap. Hero (MJ dir) 0.827.
Bigger ridge roll, flared ridge ends, darker teal and scoop, taller sacks. The ends curled too high: hero (MJ dir) 0.794.
Ridge ends curl lower, ridge roll raised, ragged shakes (random drop, skew, lift). Hero (MJ dir) 0.816.
Sign moved inside the gable so FEED reads, slumpier tied sacks, pinker planks. Final render 768 px, 48 samples: front 0.697, side 0.712, harness hero 0.727, hero (MJ dir) 0.815.

moving_parts: None. The game poses buildings itself; the construction states are the 5 static variants in variants/.
creative_additions: Curled flared ridge-log ends with pale end grain, lumpy ridge roll, windows on both eave walls (the hero shows one side), chubby round-topped stakes in the planned stage.
